auth_details: API key must be sent as Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key YOUR_API_KEY header. Free keys use api-free.deepl.com; paid keys use api.deepl.com. Self-serve signup. Legacy auth_key query/body auth ended 2026-01-15 and now fails.
paid_plans: DeepL API Growth is the current self-serve paid plan (fixed monthly/yearly price with included characters + usage overage). Enterprise API is custom via sales. DeepL API Pro is legacy and can no longer be purchased.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right. Official auth docs require Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key only (https://developers.deepl.com/docs/getting-started/auth); legacy auth_key query/body deprecation ended 2026-01-15 and such requests fail 403 (https://developers.deepl.com/docs/resources/breaking-changes-change-notices/november-2025-deprecation-of-legacy-auth-methods). paid_plans: auditor right. Official plans page states “The DeepL API Pro plan can no longer be purchased” and positions Developer (free), Growth (self-serve paid), and Enterprise (custom) as current (https://support.deepl.com/hc/en-us/articles/360021200939-DeepL-API-plans).
